scenarios.prompt: A heavy has armor on logical ticks [5,10), still takes damage/hitstop, and ignores one flinch. Define protected reaction classes and consumption identity.

criteria.ownership: Owns move-local armor only; persistent poise remains in poise-stagger.
criteria.classes: Damage, hitstop, knockback, status and grabs/throws are published independently instead of assumed.
criteria.identity: Armor windows/counts use logical ticks and stable contact identity so overlap cannot double-consume.
